Apply now about the academy 10 years, 15 cohorts, 119 companies supported, $1.6bn raised. Even the best need a refresh. We've listened to our alumni, we've watched the market mature - the traditional accelerator no longer works for high-speed startups. That's why we've launched the Seraphim Academy. Our new model removes the bottlenecks for startups accessing capital. We've created a long-term programme, with a flexible and tailored approach for startups at all stages. With new delivery partners, a broader global network, the intakes will be smaller, but the offer is way bigger. Seraphim Academy is the venture-led programme for SpaceTech startups ready to grow. UK/rest of World USA About About Team Focus ESG Portfolio SpaceTech Tracker SSIT (Growth Fund) Academy Funds Space Venture Fund Co-invest Insights News & Case Studies Research Insights Podcast & Videos Contact Harnessing the potential of SpaceTech Join Generation Space, with Seraphim as your Mission Control. Seraphim is the world’s leading specialist investor in SpaceTech, backing technologies that strengthen global security, enable resilient infrastructure, and address the planet’s most urgent challenges. Our platform spans the full innovation lifecycle, from idea to IPO: Seraphim Space Investment Trust PLC – our growth-stage listed fund, Seraphim Space Venture Fund II – our early-stage venture capital fund and Seraphim Academy – a selective early-stage platform helping startups raise capital, secure customers, and scale internationally. Learn more Not just a Fund We’re Entrepreneurs, Scientists and explorers We're Mission Control for SpaceTech Founders Our interconnected model is to identify, support and grow early stage SpaceTech companies across the full life cycle, from inception to exit. We are backed by leading Space corporates and international space agencies across our activities including investors in the Fund(s) Airbus, SES, Teledyne, Telespazio, SSTL MDA and partnerships

We are backed by leading Space corporates and international space agencies across our activities including investors in the Fund(s) Airbus, SES, Teledyne, Telespazio, SSTL MDA and partnerships including the UK and European Space Agency.
We’ve supported over 150 SpaceTech companies and generated significant Co-Investment opportunities for our LPs at Series B and beyond.

Discover our portfolio Meet your Mission control Meet the team Mark Boggett CEO & General Partner Read more Mark Boggett CEO & General Partner Mark Boggett is CEO and General Partner of Seraphim, the leading investment firm dedicated exclusively to the global SpaceTech sector.
In 2016, he helped launch the world’s first venture capital fund focused on SpaceTech, delivering top-decile returns.

Today, Seraphim manages a full-stack investment platform, including the London Stock Exchange-listed growth-stage fund Seraphim Space Investment Trust (SSIT), the early-stage fund Seraphim Space Ventures II (SSVII) with a latest close of over $100 million, and the Seraphim Space Accelerator, the largest VC-led programme in the sector.
Under Mark’s leadership, Seraphim has established itself as a pioneering force in SpaceTech investment and a trusted partner for investors seeking exposure to the next generation of space innovation.

James Bruegger CIO & General Partner Read more James Bruegger CIO & General Partner James, co-founder and CIO of Seraphim Space Manager LLP and co-founder of Generation Space LLC, Seraphim Space Accelerator and Generation Space Accelerator.
He is a prolific venture capital investor in the global SpaceTech domain.
James was an early venture capital investor in Arqit, ICEYE, LeoLabs and D-Orbit and led investments in several companies that went public, including Spire Global and AST SpaceMobile.
James holds a first-class degree in History from University College London.
James has been a fund representative on the boards of a range of global leading SpaceTech companies, including ICEYE, D-Orbit, Ultrasoc, ALL.SPACE (formerly Isotropic Systems) and SatVu.

Rob Desborough General Partner & Chair of Seraphim Academy Read more Rob Desborough General Partner & Chair of Seraphim Academy Rob is a General Partner at Seraphim Space and co-founder of Generation Space, heading up the early stage investments.
